turns.text: And we need to get back together and uncover ourselves with each other and figure out how do we adapt in an inevitably uncertain world.
turns.zh: 而且我们需要重新聚在一起，彼此敞开心扉，弄清楚我们该如何在一个不可避免充满不确定性的世界里适应下来。

turns.text: One of the things that you said in this book is that when you released “Becoming” several years ago, it was like a breath of fresh air after the time that your family spent in the White House.
turns.zh: 你在书里提到的一件事是，几年前你出版《成为》的时候，那就像是你家人在白宫度过那段时间之后的一股清风。

turns.text: So I'm curious to you, as you're about to set off on your book tour, as you're bringing this book into the world, if that was a big breath, if that was a release, what does this process feel like?
turns.zh: 所以我很好奇，对你来说，当你即将开始新书巡回宣传、把这本书带给世界的时候，如果那次是深呼吸、是一种释放，那这次这个过程感觉如何？

turns.text: Oh, you know, I… whenever you are putting yourself out into the public, I am no different.
turns.zh: 哦，你知道，我……每当你把自己放到公众面前，我也不例外。

turns.text: You know, I mean, I talk about in this book how even though “Becoming” was a breath of fresh air, there's something about making yourself vulnerable in the world.
turns.zh: 你知道，我是说，我在这本书里谈到，尽管《成为》是一股清风，但让自己在这个世界上变得脆弱，总有些什么。

turns.text: We may make it look easy, but we still go through that doubting process.
turns.zh: 我们可能让它看起来很容易，但我们仍然会经历那个自我怀疑的过程。
我是不是分享得太多了？
